- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The expansion raised several environmental concerns, including habitat destruction due to excavation and the construction of new locks.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Efforts have been made to mitigate negative impacts, such as installing sediment traps and building wetlands to protect water quality.
